why: The answer covers none of the required facts. It says nothing about "Publish and share" or "Publish live", and it never says a sandbox needs an invite to publish. It only describes setting a blog post's status to published and admits it has no information on publishing the app itself.
The answer says the steps apply once the app is live and that the section shows an A record and a TXT record to add at the domain provider. It does not mention any price for domains.

The answer names the Model Context Protocol and says AI agents use the app's operations as tools, which covers the first two facts. It cites the docs URL fragment "#mcp" and the command "smithable mcp", but it never mentions a "/mcp" endpoint. It also says nothing about "the same key". Because two required facts are missing, the answer is incomplete.

The answer states all three required facts: only an administrator can make a key, it is done on the users page (the Team page in the status starter), and the key is shown once so it must be copied right away. No mustNot items exist, so none are violated.

The answer says Ask is a panel in an app, that users ask questions about its records in their own words, and that it reads only the records the asker may read. That covers all three required facts, and there are no mustNot items to violate.

The answer does not state either required fact. It never says that pricing and plans are not set, and it never says the beta is free. It says the software is free and open source and that the docs give no hosting price for Invoicely, which is not the same as pricing being unset. It does avoid the forbidden facts, since it gives no monthly price or per-app price, but missing both required facts makes it incorrect.

The answer covers "Export CSV on a list page" and mentions "Download everything", but it never says it produces a .zip. It also never states that the download contains code, history, data and uploads. Two of the three required facts are therefore missing or incomplete. No mustNot items are violated.

The answer says data is in the app's database and attachments are under DATA_DIR/uploads/, but it never states that data is stored in Sweden and never says backups are kept in the same region. Both required facts are missing, and it mentions nothing about the data's location or region.

The answer says yes, but it never mentions Docker or the "smithable deploy" command, both of which are required under must. It only covers environment variables and API keys, so two of the three required facts are missing.

The answer says "No, you do not need an AI model", which covers the "no" fact. It also says everything works without one, "including starters, Studio, every operation, deploy and backup", which covers "operations need no model". There are no mustNot items to violate.
The answer states that a sandbox started without signing up lasts two hours, which satisfies the one required fact. There are no mustNot constraints to violate.

The answer covers all three required facts: it says to use Import on the Customers list page, that Import reads a CSV file, and that the Excel sheet should be saved as CSV first (Save as, then CSV). It never says xlsx files are read directly. It actually implies the opposite by requiring the CSV conversion.
Svaret anger varken att antalet är 10 eller att varje app har en live- och en staging-kopia. Det säger bara att informationen saknas, så båda obligatoriska fakta fattas.
The answer says it does not know the count and defers to the mail provider's limits. It states neither required fact: 100 recipients a day per app, and 1,000 recipients a month per account.

The answer states the €2 a month allowance and says that changes made through forms, in the code, or in words the built-in rules understand still work. Both required facts are covered, and there is no mustNot to violate.

The answer mentions the "Calls in card" on the project page, which covers the "calls in" fact. It also says typing /incident in Slack creates an incident, which covers "a slash command makes a record". It describes manual setup with a Slack app, Signing Secret, and command URL, and never mentions a Connect button that signs in to Slack, so the mustNot is not violated.
The answer opens with "No", saying the app does not depend on Smithable, and it names the `smithable detach` command. Both required facts are present, and there are no mustNot items to violate.

Vastaus ei sisällä kumpaakaan vaadituista tosiasioista. Se ei mainitse, että tuetut kielet ovat englanti ja ruotsi, eikä sitä, että uusi kieli lisätään pyynnöstä. Vastaus väittää vain, että sovellus on englanniksi ilman kielivalintaa, mikä on ristiriidassa ruotsin tuen kanssa. Se ei kuitenkaan väitä suomen olevan jo tuettu, joten kielletty fakta ei toteudu.
The answer says it does not know how to publish the app and gives no steps. It mentions neither "Publish and share" nor "Publish live", which are the required facts, so it fails the must criteria.
Svaret anger varken att datan lagras i Sverige eller att säkerhetskopior finns i samma region. Det säger i stället att svaret är okänt, så båda obligatoriska fakta saknas.

Vastaus ei sisällä kumpaakaan vaadittua asiaa. Se sanoo vain, ettei vastaaja tiedä Smithablen hinnoittelusta, mutta ei kerro, ettei hinnoittelua ole päätetty, eikä että beta on ilmainen. Se ei myöskään mainitse kuukausihintaa, joten kielletty kohta ei toteudu.

The answer mentions the "Sign in with Google" page, which covers the first required fact, but it never says anything about "under Connections". The second required fact is missing, so the answer is incomplete.

The answer calls staging "the second copy of a published app, next to live," but never says it is a separate copy with its own data. The rest covers incoming entry addresses and a shared secret for live and staging, and says nothing about data separation. Calling it a copy is not enough to satisfy the required fact, and the shared secret detail does not imply separate data. The required fact is not stated.

The answer says a beta tester can hand the app over and download the code, history and data first, which roughly covers "download everything". But it never mentions a transfer link or that the link is valid for seven days, so one required fact is missing.

The answer says Smithable keeps a short description of the app in smithable.yml and generates the code from it, which is the spec-and-generate fact. It also says routine changes are checked, tested, undoable operations, which covers the undoable-operations fact. No mustNot items exist, so nothing is violated.

The answer says it doesn't know the photo storage limit, so it never states the required facts: a 2 GB per app limit, or that uploaded files are included in it. The details it does give (each item needs a photo, photos are reviewed) don't cover either fact.

Svaret nämner inte de två obligatoriska fakta: att man använder en nyckel från Team-sidan (det sägs bara "en nyckel", utan att den hämtas från Team-sidan) och "/mcp" (ingen hänvisning till /mcp). Det beskriver i stället kommandot smithable mcp och assistant-rollen, vilket inte uppfyller kraven.

The answer does not state any of the required facts. It says hosting location and data export are not in the docs, so it omits "hosted in Sweden" and "backups in the same region". It also never mentions "Download everything (.zip)" or "a transfer link". It mentions CSV export and Git commits instead, which are different facts.
